controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.syslog-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*curl*" OR message LIKE "*bash*" OR message LIKE "*base64*" OR message LIKE "*sh*" OR message LIKE "*exec*")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, process.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
